notes.title: EXTRA CHAPTER ADDED
notes.content:
Old Gods Rising now has a new chapter that picks things back up immediately after the final credits have ended.

Prepare yourself for the unexpected, as a total genre-flip sees Professor Winston continue his journey into the mysterious, dangerous world of the Old Gods.

(Jump straight to the new section by typing OGR into the main menu screen)

Additional fixes and improvements include:

- Inverse mouse setting added
- Increased mouse sensitivity control
- Autosave system updated
- Streaming system upgrades

notes.title: Old Gods Rising Update
notes.content:
46 achievements are now available for Old Gods Rising.

Issues with memory leakage have been fixed, which should improve streaming as well as general run-time performance.

A new memory management system has been implemented.

Collision bugs fixed.
